extracted.intended_audience: registrants, lobbyists, and members of the public accessing or filing LDA reports
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for filing and accessing Lobbying Disclosure Act reports (Registrations LD-1, Quarterly Activity LD-2, and Contributions LD-203), and for registrants to obtain or reset filing-system credentials. Also points to public access methods and external resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public availability of LDA reports
rubrics_metrics.description: The law requires all reports filed under the LDA, as amended, are made available to the public over the Internet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reports are posted online for public access. The site emphasizes public disclosure as a statutory requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of reports included
rubrics_metrics.description: The LDA reports include lobbying Registrations (LD-1), Quarterly Activity Reports (LD-2) and Contributions Reports (LD-203).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These three report types are the core filings covered by the system; Contributions Reports are specifically filed under section 203 of the Honest Leadership and Open Government Act (HLOGA).

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal basis and effective date for Contributions Reports
rubrics_metrics.description: The Contributions Reports are filed under section 203 of the Honest Leadership and Open Government Act (HLOGA), the first of which was required to be filed by registrants and lobbyists by July 30, 2008.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contributions reporting obligations stem from HLOGA section 203 and have been in effect since the July 30, 2008 deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access methods — search for specific reports
rubrics_metrics.description: Reports may be accessed in two ways: Search — If you're looking for specific reports, search either... Registrations & Quarterly Activity Reports & Contributions Reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the site search interface when seeking particular registrant, quarterly activity, or contribution filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access methods — download via REST API
rubrics_metrics.description: Reports may be accessed in two ways: Download — If you want all reports, use our... REST API.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For bulk access or to retrieve all reports, use the provided REST API endpoint(s) to download data programmatically.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registrant account setup — new registrants
rubrics_metrics.description: Get access to filing systems: New Registrants: Request User ID & Password.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New registrants must request a user ID and password to access the filing systems and submit required reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registrant account maintenance — existing registrants
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Existing registrants who have lost credentials should use the password reset procedure to regain access to filing systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lookup registrant and client IDs
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A lookup tool is available to find registrant and client identification numbers needed for searches and filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing procedure — Registrations and Quarterly Activity (LD-1/LD-2)
rubrics_metrics.description: File Registration/Quarterly Activity (LD-1/LD-2) Reports — Registrants & Lobbyists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registrants and lobbyists use the filing system to submit LD-1 (registration) and LD-2 (quarterly activity) reports according to LDA requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing procedure — Contributions (LD-203)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contributions (LD-203) reports have a separate filing procedure; use the contributions filing function to submit these disclosures as required by HLOGA section 203.

rubrics_metrics.name: Where to find more LDA guidance and resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Go to lobbyingdisclosure.house.gov or disclosure.senate.gov for more on LDA guidance, filing deadlines, registration thresholds, frequently asked questions, ADA accommodations, LDA laws and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to the House and Senate lobbying disclosure sites for detailed guidance on deadlines, thresholds, FAQs, ADA accommodations, statutory text, and further filing information.
